metadata.title: January 21, 2011 - Money-Back Offer
metadata.author: by Alice Long / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: Introduction to the Man in Black?
Street from Broadway to South Street
You might hear it from someone who doesn't call
On the left half of the no. line
It means the world to us
Miniature loaf in a spotted wrapper?
"It ain't over till it's over" speaker
Offbeat handwriting that's hard to make out?
He appears on Italy's two-euro coin
Source of batches that are very chewy?
Short story collection by Isaac Asimov
British flag waved in a courteous manner?
Two fifths of a dead man's hand
Where you pour vinegar when making colorful slaw?
